verdict.rationale: Outlook documents its own Inbox rules for handling incoming mail, including forwarding specific messages, so the routing half of the story is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows assigning a conversation to a teammate or tracking explicit ownership. Send-on-behalf delegation and categories are adjacent features, not assignment. missing for 10: conversation assignment to teammates, explicit ownership tracking, team-level (shared mailbox) routing rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit

citations.quote: Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
Apps can set up [Inbox rules](/en-us/graph/api/resources/messagerule) to promptly handle incoming messages and reduce email clutter.
